description: This file defines the MySQLSaver class, which manages checkpoint storage and retrieval in a MySQL database for a memory component in a language processing system. It includes methods for database setup, CRUD operations on checkpoints, and chat message handling.

classes.name: MySQLSaver
classes.description: A class that handles saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting checkpoints in a MySQL database, and manages chat messages for a memory system.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates the table name to ensure it contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new DataSource connection to the database based on configuration options.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Creates the checkpoints table in the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getTuple
methods.description: Retrieves a checkpoint tuple from the database based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists checkpoint tuples from the database with optional limit and pagination.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Saves a checkpoint and its metadata into the database, updating if it already exists.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all checkpoints associated with a given thread ID.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages associated with a session ID, optionally converting them to base messages.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder method for adding chat messages (not implemented).

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat messages for a given session ID.
